senses.sense_definition: To keep something safe from harm, injury, or destruction.

examples.text: We must do everything we can to <w>preserve</w> the environment.

target_lang_translations.de: Wir müssen alles tun, um die Umwelt zu <w>erhalten</w>.

target_lang_translations.it: Il museo lavora per <w>preservare</w> la storia locale per le generazioni future.

target_lang_definitions.tr: Belirli bir kişiye veya gruba özgü olan faaliyet, iş veya konu.
